No કડી, દુહો, પદ or ટેક markers exist in this chapter (01_meta.json structure_inventory: kadi=0, duha=0, pad=0, tek_occurrences=0, verse_note explicitly records this as a measured fact, not an empty field) — the કડી/દુહો/પદ/ટેક sub-checks are not applicable to a pure-prose નવલકથાખંડ.

Not a mixed chapter: genre 'નવલકથાખંડ (વાર્તા)' with active_genre_profiles ['varta.md'] holds for the whole chapter; profiles/genres/_genre_index.md's fold table and varta.md's own provenance list both name std-9 ch4 સિંહનું મૃત્યુ as a measured નવલકથાખંડ example of this exact profile, so the profile choice itself is independently corroborated, not merely copied from 01_meta.json.

The chapter's own excerpt is self-contained (01_meta.json's explanation_unit note: the death, postmortem, funeral and villages' grief all resolve inside this printed excerpt, nothing deferred to the rest of 'અકૂપાર'), so varta.md's નવલકથાખંડ excerpt rule ('cut only the ઘટના actually printed, never invent a resolution') is satisfiable and 02_structure.json's notes confirm no topic narrates beyond original_chunk.

The વળાંક sentence 'પડતાં વેંત સિંહનું માથું ફાટી ગયું.' is kept inside one topic (M2.S4.T9, topic_category='climax') and not opened early or split across two topics, matching 01_meta.json's explicit warning and varta.md's hard-gate-4 (spoiling the turn early): no objective or topic_name for T1–T8 names the death outcome; O8 (the only objective naming the death) is anchored to T9 itself, the climax topic.

No objective, topic_name, module_name or segment_name violates varta.md's avoid list: no summary-only phrasing, no tacked-on બોધ ('આ વાર્તા આપણને શીખવે છે…'/'બોધ એ છે કે…' pattern), no evaluative label on a sympathetic character (એહમદ, the driver, the villagers are all named neutrally or with respect), no dialect standardised in a topic name, no debunking language (N/A, not a પૌરાણિક કથા). original_chunk is still empty at this stage (Agent 5's job per 02_structure.json's own note), so the avoid-list checks that bite on explanation/summary prose (hard gates 1 and 2 in full) are correctly out of scope for Agent 4 and deferred to Agent 13.

Dialect preservation is a structural commitment already visible at this stage: 02_structure.json's per-topic notes for T4, T5, T7, T8, T10 name the exact ગીર/સોરઠી તળપદા forms (સ્હાવજ, સાવજ, રાત્ય, આંય, સે, નથ્ય, ગ્યો, હાલ્યો, દોયડે, ઓલીકોર) that must survive verbatim into original_chunk at Agent 5, per varta.md hard-gate-6 — this is a forward commitment recorded now, not yet checkable against content.

All 18 markers in 00_chapter_normalized.md accounted for and correctly split into topic vs. apparatus: [[લેખક-પરિચય]]->M1.S1.T1, [[કૃતિ-પરિચય]]->M1.S1.T2, and the 9 [[ઘટના: ...]] markers -> M2.S2.T3, M2.S2.T4, M2.S3.T5, M2.S3.T6, M2.S3.T7, M2.S4.T8, M2.S4.T9, M2.S5.T10, M2.S5.T11, in printed order throughout, matching page order exactly (verified by walking 00_chapter_normalized.md line-by-line against the module/segment/topic tree).

No સ્વાધ્યાય block became a topic: cross-checked all 4 exercise_inventory entries (MCQ 'પ્રશ્નની નીચે આપેલા વિકલ્પોમાંથી...', 'બે-ત્રણ વાક્યમાં ઉત્તર', 'છ-સાત વાક્યમાં ઉત્તર', 'વિદ્યાર્થી-પ્રવૃત્તિ') against every topic_name and original_chunk plan in 02_structure.json's 11 topics — zero overlap. 02_structure.json's own notes independently confirm the same cross-check.

No topic covers text that no marker claims: each of the 11 topics maps 1:1 to its own marker block with no topic spanning two markers and no marker split across two topics.

The one judgment call worth naming for the record: [[લેખક-પરિચય]] and [[કૃતિ-પરિચય]] became two CONCEPT topics (T1, T2) even though 01_meta.json's own extraction_notes label this pair 'અપરાટસ/શિક્ષક-સંબોધિત' when explaining why it is absent from exercise_inventory.
